ambiguity_effects.explain: Grammatically that sits closer to Meridian contract, but contracts do not end at a specific clock time of day, only meetings do, so a careful reader resolves this to the meeting's end time. It does not change which record is selected either way.

turn2.naturalness_note: The sentence packs several qualifiers into one relative clause, but that is reasonable here since the calendar has five same-titled Client sync events on the same day and this level of detail is what disambiguates them. Nothing in the phrasing looks artificial or test-only.
